title: Kate Simic:
title_short: Kate Simic · My Three Kids Are Here
headline: A mom who started 4EveryKid Twin Cities watches her own three kids serve other kids.
story: Kate co-founded 4EveryKid Twin Cities. Today her three kids are volunteering beside her. Her daughter spent the day chatting and making friends with the girls who were getting shoes.

Then the why: new shoes are sometimes the first new thing a child has ever had, and you can see it in their faces: the joy, the light, the excitement. She ends as a mom: her hope for her own kids is that they belong and have a place in this world. That is what she wants for every kid here. Warm and positive.
